title: NLP-LTU at SemEval-2023 Task 10: The Impact of Data Augmentation and Semi-Supervised Learning Techniques on Text Classification Performance on an Imbalanced Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of fine-tuned transformer-based models (such as BERTweet, RoBERTa, and DeBERTa) in detecting and categorizing sexist social media posts. The evaluation uses the EDOS (Explainable Detection of Online Sexism) dataset across three tasks: binary sexism detection, 4-class coarse sexism classification, and 11-class fine-grained categorization, measured using macro-averaged F1-scores.
